chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, elected some people from His creation for fulfilling the needs of the destitute amongst the Shi'ah of Ali (peace be upon him) that He may reward them for that with Paradise.
ai.seo_question: Who did Allah elect to help the poor among the Shi'ah of Ali?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights that Allah has specially selected certain individuals to fulfill the needs of the poor among the followers of Imam Ali (peace be upon him), promising them Paradise as a reward for this service. This narration underscores the concept of *intikhab* (divine selection) for charitable acts, linking material assistance to spiritual elevation within the Shia tradition of *khumus* and voluntary charity. It emphasizes that serving the *Shi'a* (followers) of the Ahl al-Bayt is a distinct pathway to divine pleasure and eternal reward.
